comment: SPR-I.4.5 golden cases for the scoring kinds beyond the first three, over the same chart as takes.json: | Dm7 | G7 | Cmaj7 | % | in C, 4/4, 120 bpm (a beat is 500 ms, a bar 2000 ms). Dm7 guide tones are F and C, G7's are B and F, Cmaj7's are E and B. Hand-checked musical judgements: change one only with a reason and a judge_version bump.

cases.name: guide tones: a line of thirds and sevenths that steps from chord to chord is full marks
cases.why: C the seventh of Dm7 steps down to B the third of G7; F the seventh of G7 steps down to E the third of Cmaj7

cases.name: guide tones: a root is not a guide tone, and a leap into the next chord is not a connection
cases.why: three of four notes are guide tones; of the two chord changes, D to B is a leap and only F to E connects: (3 + 1) of (4 + 2)

cases.name: guide tones: a step of a whole tone still connects, a minor third does not
cases.why: F to G into G7 is a whole tone but G is the root, not a guide tone, so that change does not connect; F to E does: (4 + 1) of (5 + 2)

cases.name: guide tones: nothing played is nought
approach notes: every target on the named beats reached from a half step is full marks
cases.why: Eb into D on beat 3 of Dm7, F# into G on beat 1 of G7; both outside notes a semitone below, both landing within a beat

cases.name: approach notes: a target landed on with no approach before it is a target missed
cases.why: C on beat 1 of Cmaj7 is a chord tone on a named beat, so it is a target, and nothing led into it

cases.name: approach notes: the named beats default to the downbeat
cases.why: Eb into E on the downbeat of Cmaj7, F# into G on the downbeat of G7

cases.name: approach notes: no targets at all is nought, not a crash
rhythm motif: every onset of the pattern in every bar, on time, is full marks, whatever the pitches
cases.why: the pattern is beats 1, the and of 2, 3 and the and of 4; the notes are chromatic nonsense and that is fine

cases.name: rhythm motif: one onset late by more than the tolerance is one onset missed
cases.why: 15 of 16 onsets, the tolerance at 120 bpm being 50 ms

cases.name: rhythm motif: hammering every eighth does not match the pattern, it buries it
cases.why: all 16 onsets are hit, but 32 notes were played: 16 of 32

cases.name: rhythm motif: playing only half the bars is half the marks
call and response: the answer in the answer bar with the same rhythm and shape is full marks
cases.why: the call D E F rises on beats 1, 2, 3; the answer G A B rises on the same beats of bar 3

cases.name: call and response: the right rhythm with the wrong shape loses the shape
cases.why: three onsets in time, but the answer goes down then up where the call went up and up: 3 + 1 of 3 + 2

cases.name: call and response: when exact notes are asked for, the same shape in another place is not the phrase
cases.why: three onsets in time, no note the same: 3 + 0 of 3 + 3

cases.name: call and response: exact notes an octave away are the same notes
call and response: notes outside the answer bar are not the answer
cases.why: the call bar is the band's turn; playing along with it is not answering

cases.name: comping voicings is not a kind this version scores
